StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

ModifyDamageCap.rationale: `target != base.Owner -> decimal.MaxValue` maps to `return None` (powers.py:2090), which cmds.py:62 reads as "no cap"; otherwise both return base.Amount. Two things checked. (1) The cap is applied to EVERY damage type on both sides -- cmds.py:60-63 sits OUTSIDE the `is_powered_attack` gate, and C# runs ModifyDamageCap in the same unconditional ModifyDamageInternal pass as the additive/multiplicative families (Hook.cs:2533-2542) -- so the pipeline-level gate that makes SurroundedPower a gap does not touch this power. (2) The MIN-of-all-caps aggregation matches: C# folds `if (num5 < num4) num4 = num5` over the listeners and the sim's dispatcher returns the minimum, so multiple caps compose identically (Intangible's cap 1 plus this power's). Owner is the ported Hive Exoskeleton. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterModifyingDamageAmount.rationale: The whole body is `Flash();` -- presentation only. Recorded rather than skipped because it is the companion notification for a modifier chain, i.e. power_cmd gap G4's shape one family over, and here it costs nothing.

guards.rationale: Closed game-wide, re-verified 2026-07-26. EXECUTED: `py audit/tools/power_census.py visible` reports 0 IsVisibleInternal overrides of 260 files.
